title: Uncle-niece mating
summary: A man has a child with his sister's daughter: a union across generations.
shows: A man (II-1) has a child (IV-1) with his niece (III-1), his sister's daughter. They are related as half-siblings are, so the child's inbreeding coefficient is 1/8.
Uncle-niece marriages recur in the Spanish Habsburgs, another example on this site.
hard: The partners belong to different generations. The partnership has to join a person in one generation's row to a person in the next, without its line or the child's line running through anyone between them.
